entities.name: Dragonstorms
entities.description: Elemental storms born of Ugin's living essence and Tarkir that spawn fully formed dragons and reshape the land.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane with a unique dracometeorological ecosystem in which dragons are born from storms.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: An elder dragon planeswalker built into Tarkir's ecology whose essence empowers the dragonstorms.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Ugin's twin brother, sealed in the Meditation Realm after the War of the Spark, who escapes in the aftermath of Jace's spell.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: A former planeswalker who finds the Stormnexus Ritual and later works with Elspeth to end the dragonstorm outbreaks.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: An angelic planeswalker who investigates the dragonstorms and defeats Sarkhan.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A desparked dragon-obsessed character who casts a corrupted Stormnexus Ritual and is defeated by Ugin.

entities.name: Taigam
entities.description: A figure who desires the dragons' return and helps Sarkhan cast the corrupted ritual.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker who warns Elspeth and Narset about Sarkhan's dragon form.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who attempts a reality-bending spell in the Meditation Realm and is shattered.

entities.name: Loot
entities.description: A creature accompanying Jace in the Meditation Realm.

entities.name: Stormnexus Ritual
entities.description: A spell that calls forth the soul of Tarkir, raising a dragonstorm and five spirit dragons.

entities.name: Meditation Realm
entities.description: The realm where Ugin and Bolas were sealed after the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Omenpaths
entities.description: Pathways between planes that let Tarkiri dragons and dragonstorms appear elsewhere.

entities.name: Dragonlords
entities.description: The oppressive dragon rulers defeated by the clan leaders and their spirit dragons.

entities.name: Spirit dragons
entities.description: Five untethered spirits that emerge from the Stormnexus Ritual and bond with the five new clan leaders.

events.summary: Ugin arrives on Tarkir and forms the plane, his wing beats birthing the dragonstorms.
events.quote: his wing beats birthed the dragonstorms.

events.summary: Gravely injured by Nicol Bolas, Ugin hibernates in a nest of hedrons while his essence empowers the dragonstorms.
events.quote: he entered a long hibernation inside a nest of hedrons

events.summary: Ugin awakens and departs Tarkir, lessening the dragonstorms.
events.quote: When Ugin awoke from his hibernation and departed Tarkir in 4559 AR

events.summary: Narset uncovers the Stormnexus Ritual scroll and is persuaded to use it.
events.quote: she uncovered a spell scroll for the Stormnexus Ritual

events.summary: The ritual raises a dragonstorm and five spirit dragons; the dragonlords are defeated and swallowed by the storm.
events.quote: the dragonlords were defeated by the clan leaders and their spirit dragons and seemingly swallowed up by the massive storm.

events.summary: The ritual reactivates the dragonstorms, which spiral out of control.
events.quote: the spell had also reactivated the dragonstorms.

events.summary: Tarkiri dragons and dragonstorms begin appearing on other planes through the Omenpaths.
events.quote: Tarkiri dragons began appearing on other planes.

events.summary: Elspeth approaches Narset about the dragonstorms spreading across the Multiverse.
events.quote: Narset was approached by the angelic planeswalker Elspeth Tirel

events.summary: Elspeth defeats the desparked Sarkhan in battle.
events.quote: Sarkhan engaged Elspeth in battle but his desparked form was no match for the archangel and he was quickly defeated.

events.summary: Taigam helps Sarkhan cast a corrupted Stormnexus Ritual, giving him control of the wild dragons.
events.quote: Taigam helped Sarkhan cast a corrupted form of the Stormnexus Ritual

events.summary: Ajani warns Narset and Elspeth that Sarkhan has become an enormous dragon laying waste to the countryside.
events.quote: they were warned by Ajani Goldmane that Sarkhan Vol had taken the form of an enormous dragon

events.summary: Elspeth and Narset encounter Jace, Loot, Ugin and Bolas in the Meditation Realm.
events.quote: they encountered Jace Beleren and the creature Loot

events.summary: Jace's reality-bending spell fails and he shatters like glass as the Realm unmakes itself.
Ugin escapes to Tarkir and defeats Sarkhan with ghostfire, but Bolas escapes in the aftermath.
events.quote: Ugin was able to escape the devastation of the Realm, reappeared on Tarkir, and immediately defeated Sarkhan with his ghostfire

relations.quote: the twin brothers Ugin and Bolas

relations.note: Bolas gravely injured Ugin in battle.
relations.quote: After Ugin was gravely injured in a battle with his twin Nicol Bolas in 3279 AR

relations.note: They travel together to end the outbreaks.
relations.quote: Together they traveled to the Crucible of the Spirit Dragon.

relations.note: Helps him cast the corrupted ritual.
relations.quote: Taigam helped Sarkhan cast a corrupted form of the Stormnexus Ritual
immediately defeated Sarkhan with his ghostfire
they were warned by Ajani Goldmane
